commits.message:
docs: make the roadmap order-independent, describe the beacon timer accurately

Review feedback:
- ROADMAP.md stated #141's results (smaller data file, metrics job removed, OG
  gating) as done although #141 can merge after this PR. Describe them as the
  separate PRs they are (#140, #141) so the entry is true in any merge order.
- The analytics doc said the beacon loads 500 ms after load; the timer starts
  when the inline head script runs, not on the load event.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #138 from and3rn3t/style/css-purge

style(css): remove ~1,600 lines of dead CSS, merge scattered media blocks

fix(js): whileVisible only runs when on screen and tab visible

Review feedback: returning to a hidden tab called start() even when the canvas
had scrolled offscreen in the meantime. Track both conditions and re-evaluate
on either change. The first evaluation always fires so an element that starts
offscreen still gets stop(). Adds tests for both cases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #130 from and3rn3t/perf/first-paint

perf: faster first paint and ~460 KB less font weight

Merge main into chore/modernize-phase1

Resolve cryptography pin conflicts: keep main's v50 security floor with a
looser upper bound (>=50,<51). Pin the new lint job's actions to the same
SHAs Renovate used.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore(css): only exempt raw lengths that sit inside clamp/max/min/env

Review feedback: the lookahead exempted a whole declaration as soon as any
allowed function appeared, so 'padding: max(var(--space-4), env(...)) 12px'
passed. The pattern now walks the value and fails on a raw px/rem/em length at
the top level, skipping only whole clamp/max/min/env/var calls; calc() is not
skipped. Moved the config to stylelint.config.mjs so the pattern is built from
named pieces instead of repeated three times in JSON. Probe cases: six allowed
forms pass, six disallowed (including the one above and calc(1rem + 2px)) fail.
The real stylesheet has no new violations.

CLAUDE.md now says px/rem/em, and that the exemption is for lengths inside the
functions.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

ci: run Lighthouse as a post-deploy job instead of on workflow_run

actionlint rejects a reusable-workflow call under the low-trust workflow_run
trigger without an explicit cache limit. Run the audit as a job in pages.yml
(needs: deploy, push events only) instead: same 'audit the new build'
behaviour, trusted trigger. lighthouse.yml keeps the weekly and manual runs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
(cherry picked from commit 439093ea1388f8700bb30d15d27c211d94b2c44e)

style(css): drop empty universal rule left by the prefix removal

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
